response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong senior-level software engineering expertise with 16+ years of experience, this Principal Performance Architect role requires core competency in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, and AI accelerator optimization that is absent from their entirely software-focused background. This represents a fundamental domain mismatch unsuitable for a principal-level hardware architecture position.
strengths: Senior/Principal-level track record with demonstrated progression and technical leadership across multiple companies and domains
Strong performance and systems optimization mindset from low-latency, high-performance distributed systems work at Dunnhumby handling millions of requests
Systems-level programming experience with C, C++, and DLang demonstrating comfort with lower-level technical domains
concerns: No hardware design, SoC modeling, or IP architecture experience despite these being core job requirements at principal level
Complete absence of GPU architecture, AI accelerator, or deep learning inference/training optimization experience
Career trajectory exclusively software-focused with no evidence of hardware-software co-design or direct involvement in hardware optimization for accelerators

key_factors.factor: No AI/deep learning workload optimization background
Strong systems engineering and performance optimization background
